_notes: Modes and words of the write-time checks (hooks/shared/evidence_check.py, hooks/write_checks.py). None asks a model. Change a mode here with no code change: 'off' runs nothing, 'shadow' logs only, 'advisory' notes, 'gate' returns. Mode words are read without regard to case and 'enforce' reads 'gate'; when this file cannot be read, is malformed or names no known mode, each check uses its shipped mode (hooks/shared/check_modes.py DEFAULT_MODES) and one note line goes to stderr.

handoff_evidence = 'gate': `repact accept` refuses a task while the evidence check (hooks/shared/evidence_check.py, which reads the dispatch record and the run ledger, never the HANDOFF text) finds a problem: no passing tcount run since dispatch when the inputs changed (evidence.no_run), input files changed after the run (evidence.stale_run), a pinned acceptance criterion with no run of the same test selection on the current inputs (evidence.selection_mismatch), a fix or feature with no failing run first (evidence.red_first_missing), or a case it cannot judge (evidence.needs_human). Any other mode turns each problem into a note.

commit_rule = 'off' (the shipped default): no commit message is checked. 'gate' returns, every time, a commit message with AI attribution, a body, more than one sentence or a word from commit_rule.deny_words (hooks/shared/commit_rules.py); an empty deny_words list checks no words. Every return is logged (checks/shadow.jsonl, kind write_gate) and counted by repact-report.

amendment_gate, ref_dispositions and rejection_shape were retired in 2.1.0 with the hooks that read them: `repact submit` refuses a HANDOFF that leaves an amend_<n> or a carried project task undisposed, and `repact reject` writes the rejection's shape, whatever this file says. A policy or checks.json that still names them is noted and ignored.
